# Sapphire Scents

> Sapphire Scents is a Nigerian luxury perfume house founded in 2015 by Wale Jana. It makes oud-led perfumes, scent refills and smart scent diffusers, and offers event scenting for weddings, launches and parties from ₦1.2M per event.

Prices are in Nigerian naira. Orders are placed on the website and confirmed by the Sapphire team.

- [Home and event scenting](https://www.shopsapphirescents.com/)
- [All perfumes](https://www.shopsapphirescents.com/perfumes)
- [Diffusers](https://www.shopsapphirescents.com/diffusers)
- [Scent refills](https://www.shopsapphirescents.com/refills)
- [About Sapphire Scents and Wale Jana](https://www.shopsapphirescents.com/about)
- [Contact and event bookings](https://www.shopsapphirescents.com/contact)
